Whether the maintainers intended this tradeoff is arguable, so confidence is moderate.

judged_text: The disqus import now routes every thread through TopicEmbed.import_remote, which live-fetches each thread's page over HTTP, while the same change deletes the category option and the created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) fidelity from the old PostCreator call. Operators running the previously-shipped import with -c now hit Thor's unknown-option error, every imported topic is stamped with the import time instead of the Disqus thread's date, and an N-thread import performs N live HTTP fetches with no error handling — one unreachable page kills the whole import halfway, where the old path used only local XML data.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Disqus Thor import to stop using local XML thread data and instead call `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` (lib/tasks/disqus.thor), which does `open(url).read` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` with no rescue/handling (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The previous `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` is removed, so imported topics/posts will default to current time. Also the `--category/-c` Thor option is deleted, so operators using the previously-supported flag will now get an unknown option error. These are concrete, diff-grounded behavior breakages.
